paragraphs: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation ( EK-son MOH-bəl) is an American multinational oil and gas corporation headquartered in Spring, Texas, a suburb of Houston. Founded as the largest direct successor of John D. Rockefeller's Standard Oil, the company was formed in 1999, with the merger of Exxon and Mobil. It is vertically integrated across the entire oil and gas industry, as well as within its chemicals division, which produces plastic, synthetic rubber, and other chemical products. As the largest U.S.-based oil and gas company, ExxonMobil is the eighth-largest company by revenue in the U.S. and 13th-largest in the world. It is also the largest investor-owned oil company in the world.

The company has been widely criticized and sued, mostly for environmental incidents and its history of climate change denial against the scientific consensus that fossil fuels significantly contribute to global warming. The company is responsible for many oil spills, the largest and most notable of which was the 1989 Exxon Valdez oil spill in Alaska, considered to be one of the world's worst oil spills in terms of environmental damage. The company has also been accused of human rights violations and exerting excessive influence on American foreign policy and developing countries.
In 2024, ExxonMobil was responsible for 610 Mt of CO2 emissions, which was 1.58% of global CO2 emissions.

people.name: Darren W. Woods
people.title: Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer; Director and President
people.bio: Has served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer since January 1, 2017. The executive officer listing also states that he has been Director and President since January 1, 2016.
people.quote: Darren W. Woods | 61 | Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer (since January 1, 2017)

people.name: Neil A. Chapman
people.title: Senior Vice President
people.bio: Has served as Senior Vice President since January 1, 2018, and is listed as a named executive officer for 2025.
people.quote: Neil A. Chapman | 63 | Senior Vice President (since January 1, 2018)

people.name: Neil A. Hansen
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Became Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer on February 1, 2026. Previously served as President, Global Business Solutions, and Senior Vice President, Energy Products, ExxonMobil Product Solutions Company.
people.quote: Neil A. Hansen | 51 | Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (since February 1, 2026)

people.name: Jack P. Williams, Jr.
people.title: Senior Vice President
people.bio: Has served as Senior Vice President since June 1, 2014, and is listed as a named executive officer for 2025.
people.quote: Jack P. Williams, Jr. | 62 | Senior Vice President (since June 1, 2014)

people.name: Daniel L. Ammann
people.title: Vice President; President, ExxonMobil Upstream Company
people.bio: Has served as Vice President since May 1, 2022, and President, ExxonMobil Upstream Company since February 1, 2025. Previously led Low Carbon Solutions and served as Chief Executive Officer of Cruise LLC.
people.quote: Daniel L. Ammann | 53 | Vice President (since May 1, 2022)

people.name: James R. Chapman
people.title: Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations
people.bio: Has served as Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations since May 1, 2024, following service as Vice President, Tax and Treasurer. Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer at Dominion Energy, Inc.
people.quote: James R. Chapman | 56 | Vice President, Treasurer and Investor Relations (since May 1, 2024)

people.name: Matt R. Crocker
people.title: Vice President
people.bio: Has served as Vice President since May 1, 2025. Previously served as President, Global Business Solutions, and Senior Vice President, Strategy, Product and New Assets, Low Carbon Solutions.
people.quote: Matt R. Crocker | 52 | Vice President (since May 1, 2025)

people.name: Len M. Fox
people.title: Vice President, Controller and Tax
people.bio: Has served as Vice President, Controller and Tax since May 1, 2024. Previously served as Vice President and Controller from March 1, 2021, through April 30, 2024.
people.quote: Len M. Fox | 62 | Vice President, Controller and Tax (since May 1, 2024)

people.name: Jon M. Gibbs
people.title: Senior President, ExxonMobil Global Operations
people.bio: Has served as Senior President, ExxonMobil Global Operations since January 1, 2026. Previously served as President, ExxonMobil Global Projects Company, and Senior Vice President, Global Project Delivery at that company.
people.quote: Jon M. Gibbs | 54 | Senior President, ExxonMobil Global Operations (since January 1, 2026)

people.name: Staale Gjervik
people.title: President, ExxonMobil Global Projects Company
people.bio: Has served as President, ExxonMobil Global Projects Company since January 1, 2026. Previously served as President of ExxonMobil Supply Chain and ExxonMobil Global Services Company.
people.quote: Staale Gjervik | 52 | President, ExxonMobil Global Projects Company (since January 1, 2026)

people.name: Darrin L. Talley
people.title: Vice President, Corporate Strategic Planning
people.bio: Has served as Vice President, Corporate Strategic Planning since April 1, 2022. Previously served as President, ExxonMobil Research and Engineering Company from April 1, 2020, through March 31, 2022.
people.quote: Darrin L. Talley | 61 | Vice President, Corporate Strategic Planning (since April 1, 2022)

people.name: Jeffrey A. Taylor
people.title: Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Has served as Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since July 1, 2024, following service as Deputy General Counsel. Previously served as Executive Vice President and General Counsel at Fox Corporation.
people.quote: Jeffrey A. Taylor | 61 | Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary (since July 1, 2024)

people.name: Kathryn A. Mikells
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (2025 named executive officer listing)
people.bio: Listed as a 2025 named executive officer with the title Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. She is not included in the executive officer listing as of February 18, 2026, which identifies Neil A. Hansen as Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: Kathryn A. Mikells Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Exxon Mobil Corporation

people.name: John D. Harris II
people.title: Independent director
people.bio: Served as CEO of Raytheon International, Inc. from 2013 to 2020. His Raytheon career included leadership positions in operations, contracts, supply chain, and business development.
people.quote: Mr. Harris brings to the Board a global perspective, as well as strategic, functional, and operational skills with a focus on customer success.

people.name: Kaisa H. Hietala
people.title: Independent director
people.bio: Served as Neste Corporation's Executive Vice President of Renewable Products and a member of its Executive Committee from 2014 to 2019. Her 20-year Neste career included exploration and production, crude trading, and leading the strategic review that resulted in the Renewable Products segment.
people.quote: Ms. Hietala brings a breadth of industry experience, having led the transformation of an oil and gas company

people.name: Joseph L. Hooley
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Served as State Street Chair from 2011 to 2019 and CEO from 2010 to 2018. Previously served as President and CEO of Boston Financial Data Services and National Financial Data Services.
people.quote: Mr. Hooley has extensive experience with institutional investors, having overseen the servicing of over $35 trillion of assets

people.name: Steven A. Kandarian
people.title: Independent director
people.bio: Served as MetLife President and CEO from 2011 to 2019, Chair from 2012 to 2019, and Chief Investment Officer from 2005 to 2011. Previously served as Executive Director of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation from 2001 to 2004.
people.quote: Mr. Kandarian's 14 years of senior executive leadership experience at MetLife, where he led a significant transformation following the implementation of Dodd-Frank

people.name: Alexander A. Karsner
people.title: Independent director
people.bio: Has served as Senior Strategist at X, Alphabet's Moonshot Factory, since 2013. Previously served as Managing Partner of Emerson Collective from 2016 to 2019 and U.S. Assistant Secretary of Energy from 2006 to 2008.
people.quote: Mr. Karsner's energy policy and diplomacy experience, in addition to his background in commercializing breakthrough energy technologies

people.name: Lawrence W. Kellner
people.title: Independent director
people.bio: Has served as President of Emerald Creek Group, LLC since 2010. Previously served as Continental Airlines Chairman and CEO from 2004 to 2009 and President and COO from 2003 to 2004.
people.quote: Mr. Kellner brings extensive experience in a highly regulated and capital-intensive industry, having served as CEO, COO, and Chair of Continental Airlines.

people.name: Darren W. Woods
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Joined ExxonMobil in 1992 and has served as Chairman and CEO since 2017 and President since 2016. Previously served as Senior Vice President from 2014 to 2015 and Vice President and President of ExxonMobil Refining & Supply Company from 2012 to 2014.
people.quote: Mr. Woods brings more than 30 years of global industry experience managing highly sophisticated, safety-critical operations
